niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” connected‑TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals (brand vs performance), budget, markets, desired inventory (premium/streamers vs programmatic), creative needs, and measurement requirements.

To help you quickly, here’s a practical way to pick and a short list of reputable partners by type.

How to choose
- Campaign objective: brand awareness, reach/frequency, or direct response? Different agencies excel at different objectives.  
- Inventory preference: do you want premium publisher/streamer inventory (Hulu, Roku, Peacock, etc.) or programmatic CTV buying across many apps?  
- Geography & scale: global vs regional/local.  
- Measurement needs: third‑party verification, incremental reach, cross‑screen attribution.  
- Creative: do you need bespoke CTV creative and ad formats (dynamic, interactive) or just repurposed TV spots?  
- Budget and timeline: full agency teams suit larger budgets and longer timelines; specialists can move faster for smaller tests.  

Types of partners and examples
- Global holding networks (best for large, complex/global buys + full service): GroupM (Mindshare/Wavemaker), Omnicom (OMD/PHD), Publicis (Zenith/Spark Foundry), Dentsu (Carat).  
- CTV/programmatic specialists (strong at targeting, DSPs, incremental reach): The Trade Desk (DSP partner rather than a traditional agency), Simulmedia (programmatic TV + CTV planning), VideoAmp (planning & measurement).  
- Platform/direct sellers (best for premium, first‑party inventory): Roku Advertising, Hulu/Disney ad teams, Amazon/Fire TV.  
- Creative & measurement specialists: Innovid (creative, ad serving, measurement), IAS/Moat/DoubleVerify (viewability/fraud measurement partners).  
- Independent agencies with strong CTV practice: look for independents who advertise CTV case studies in your vertical — many boutique shops focus solely on CTV strategy, buying and creative.

If you want a specific recommendation
Tell me: your campaign objective, monthly budget, target markets/audiences, whether you need creative production, and whether you prefer programmatic or direct premium placements. I’ll suggest 2–3 agencies or partners matched to your needs (and why).
